steps.action: Search and narrow step 1: Documents from navigation; Recent shows up to five Documents by current-Version upload, not by opening
steps.expected: Recent lists at most five in newest-current-Version order, and opening an older Document does not change it
steps.actual: The Documents navigation link opened the repository. Recent listed 5 Documents in the same order as the newest-current-Version read (repo-autodoc-admin-09280742.docx, repo-knowledge-admin-09280742.pdf, …). After opening the older "repo-folder-admin-09280742.docx" and returning, Recent still matched the upload-time order and did not add it.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 2: Filter, Owner, Contracts/Matters/Entities/Auto-Docs/Knowledge, Apply
steps.expected: Owner offers the five kinds and each narrows to paper of that owner kind
steps.actual: Owner offered Contracts, Matters, Entities, Auto-Docs, Knowledge. Contracts: 50 rows including repo-root-admin-09280742.pdf; Matters: 50 rows including repo-matter-admin-09280742.pdf; Entities: 50 rows including repo-entity-admin-09280742.pdf; Knowledge: 50 rows including repo-knowledge-admin-09280742.pdf; Auto-Docs: 3 rows including repo-autodoc-admin-09280742.docx. Each list left out the fixture paper of the other owner kinds.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 3: Record with Search choices; Folder becomes available for one Contract, with Record root; no Folder for Knowledge or Auto-Docs
steps.expected: Record narrows to one Contract; Folder picks the folder or Record root
steps.actual: Record with Search choices "C-249" narrowed the list to the Contract's 4 live Documents, and the Filter menu then offered Owner, Record, Folder, Format, Kind, Counterparty, Uploader, Uploaded, Show archived. Folder "DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin Repo folder" showed only "repo-folder-admin-09280742.docx"; the Folder chip's editor ("Folder Record root DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin Repo folder Choose one value Apply") switched to Record root showed the Documents outside folders. With Owner Knowledge the menu offered Owner, Record, Format, Kind, Counterparty, Uploader, Uploaded, Show archived; with Owner Auto-Docs Owner, Record, Format, Kind, Counterparty, Uploader, Uploaded, Show archived: no Folder.

steps.action: Search and narrow steps 4-5: Format and Kind take several values; different filters must all match; Kind describes the current Version; Counterparty, Uploader; Uploaded From/To includes both dates; remove one filter; Clear all; Recent hidden while filtered
steps.expected: Any-of within a filter, all-of across filters, current-Version kind, inclusive dates, and Recent only without filters
steps.actual: On C-249, Format PDF + Word ("Format PDF Word PowerPoint Image Email Other Matches any selected value Apply") kept the PDF and the Word Document and left out the text file. Kind offered General, Draft · ours, Draft · theirs, Redline · theirs, Redline · ours, Partially signed, Executed, Amendment, Generated redline. Kind Draft · ours left out "repo-root-admin-09280742.pdf", whose v1 is Draft · ours but whose current v2 is Draft · theirs; adding Draft · theirs brought it back (any of the selected values). Kind Executed left only "repo-folder-admin-09280742.docx" (row "repo-folder-admin-09280742.docx C-249 · DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin repository Contract 09280742 Executed DOCX 5.3 kB 1 DO Daniel Okafor t"); Counterparty DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin Northwind 09280742 and Uploader Daniel Okafor kept it. Uploaded From 2026-09-28 To 2026-09-28 ("Uploaded From To Includes both dates Apply") kept it; From 2026-09-29 showed "No documents match these filters.". Removing the Kind filter left the list empty; removing Uploaded widened it again. Recent was hidden while filters were active and returned after Clear all.

steps.action: Open the matching paper: selecting the name opens the owning record with the current Version; expand the chain for an earlier round
steps.expected: The record opens with the reader on v2 and the chain lists v1
steps.actual: The repository row read "repo-root-admin-09280742.pdf C-249 · DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin repository Contract 09280742 Draft · theirs PDF 33.3 kB 2 DO Daniel Okafor this minute" (owning reference C-249). Selecting "repo-root-admin-09280742.pdf" opened C-249's Documents tab with the reader on "repo-root-admin-09280742.pdf, version 2". Expanding the chain and selecting the earlier round opened version 1.

steps.action: Search and narrow closing text: global search reads only the latest Version; an earlier Version is read from the owning record's Documents tab
steps.expected: Header Search finds the Document by a word in its latest Version and not by a word only in the earlier Version; the chain on the record still opens the earlier Version
steps.actual: A PDF Document "repo-search-admin-09280742.pdf" had "zuluadmin09280742" only in v1 and "yankeeadmin09280742" only in v2 (text states ready/ready). Header Search, "yankeeadmin09280742", See all results listed it ("1 match repo-search-admin-09280742.pdf C-249 · DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin repository Contract 09280742 Fictional supplier note, second round. Marker yankeead"). The same search for "zuluadmin09280742" did not list it ("0 matches No matches No matches for “zuluadmin09280742”. Try another word or record number."). On C-249's Documents tab, "Show the 1 earlier version of repo-search-admin-09280742.pdf" expanded the chain and selecting the earlier round opened "repo-search-admin-09280742.pdf, version 1".

steps.action: Missing or archived: a hidden record's Document does not appear through a filter, the list, or a direct link
steps.expected: An Administrator reaches every Contract, so the Confidential Contract's paper is listed
steps.actual: As Administrator, Record choices for C-248 offered "DOC-032 compat compat-c hidden owner 09280742", the repository read listed its Document, and the record's Documents read answered 200. The guide does not claim an Administrator is refused.

steps.action: Missing or archived: Filter, Show archived includes archived Documents; the offered Restore brings one back
steps.expected: The archived row appears marked Archived with Restore; Restore makes it live
steps.actual: After archiving "repo-archive-admin-09280742.txt" it was absent from the Record-filtered list. Filter, Show archived added its row "repo-archive-admin-09280742.txt Archived C-249 · DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin repository Contract 09280742 — TXT 46 byte 1 DO Daniel Okafor" with a Restore action; Restore made it live again (read-back).

steps.action: Missing or archived: an empty result after filters; Clear all widens again
steps.expected: The empty answer is shown and Clear all returns the whole list
steps.actual: Record C-249 with Format Email gave "No documents match these filters. Clear filters to return to the whole list.". Clear all brought back the whole list (50 rows on the first page) and Recent documents.

steps.action: Before you start: drag a live Contract Document row onto a Move to folder target inside its owning record
steps.expected: The Move to folder panel names the record's folders and the drop files the Document
steps.actual: Dragging the "repo-drag-admin-09280742.txt" row revealed the Move to folder panel with "DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin Repo folder" as a target; dropping on "DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin Repo folder" filed the Document there (read-back).
